general.upload_label: You can click to upload and select a file, and copy the file address. This does not actually work here:
general.file_path_label: Here is the path of the file you selected. Right-click the file when uploading and select Copy file address, and paste the address into the right text box:
general.preset_label: no need to fill in the settings, one-click export

tip.ph002: After generating the command, please copy it to the command line and run it, make sure that you have configured the ffmpeg environment and added it to the environment variable
tip.ph003: Leave blank the default output in the input video folder
tip.ph004: Leave blank to add ' _ffmpeg' after the file name
tip.tip001: You need to fill in the available folder address, please end with '\'
tip.tip002: Even if you only modify the suffix, you need to fill in the complete file name, including the suffix here
tip.tip003: Video resolution, in pixels, format example 1920x1080, can be left blank, leaving blank defaults to the original resolution
tip.tip004: Video bitrate, in kbit/s, leave blank to let ffmpeg decide
tip.tip005: Set video fps, leave blank to default to the same as the original video, unit is fps
tip.tip006: Select the output video quality, which will affect the video output speed. When it is not selected, no parameters will be added
tip.tip007: This is the video decoder of the input video
tip.tip008: Select video encoder, pay attention to whether the video encoder format here is suitable for FFmpeg in your current environment, mouse over the option to view the parameters used
tip.tip009: Select audio encoder, pay attention to whether the audio encoder format here is suitable for FFmpeg in your current environment, mouse over the option to view the parameters used
tip.tip010: When this option is enabled, only the metadata of the video will be displayed, and the encoding progress will not be displayed
tip.tip011: When this option is enabled, the encoding progress will be displayed during the encoding process
tip.tip012: When this option is enabled, the output video will not be output, only the audio will be output
tip.tip013: When this option is enabled, the output audio will not be output, only the video will be output, advise the output file to be a video format
